description: Search the dated updates Jonas posts about what he is building. Matches any of the words in title, text, project and tags and ranks by how many match; without a query it returns the newest. Optional filters: project, tag, since. Each result has the full text (updates are short), tags and a URL; use get_update for one update by slug.

project.description: Optional project filter: jsplinter, personal, blockspot, voucheralarm, automateandtweak, games. ("jsplinter" = the site itself, "personal" = personal notes.)

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "astro rebuild" or "accessibility". Optional; leave out for the newest updates. Max 120 characters.

tag.description: Optional tag key as returned by list_tags, e.g. "claude-code".

name: search_updates
title: Search updates
